title: Radial Marchenko-Pastur laws: projection characterizations and rigidity
summary: Let \(R_p=\|x_p\|^2/p\Rightarrow ν\) and \(p/N\to c\in(0,\infty)\). We prove that the radial quadratic-form condition (RQC), requiring energy in deterministic subspaces to follow the parent radius, is equivalent to the following spectral property: for one fixed \(α\in(0,1)\), every deterministic rank-\(\lfloor αp\rfloor\) projected covariance has empirical spectral distribution converging to \(μ_{cα,ν}\).
